verses.1: Hazon Yeshaya, son of Amos, who saw what would happen to Judah and Jerusalem during the time of Ezekiel. He was a prophet of Judah’s kings.
verses.2: Hear, heavens! And let the earth listen too. For the LORD speaks through His children. I have grown up and become strong, but they have sinned against Me.
verses.3: Shor knew how to create them, and Abus’ son knew how to use them. But the people of Israel did not know; they did not understand.
verses.4: Oh, how wicked is this people! They are full of sin and evil. They have abandoned Jehovah. They have rejected Israel’s holiness. They have become worthless.
verses.5: Why do they still continue to do this? Every head and every heart should be turned away from it.
verses.6: From the feet to the head, there is no wound or injury. It’s not damaged or broken in any way.
verses.7: Your land is in ruins; it has been burned by fire. Your land belongs to those who are foreign to you. They eat it, and your land becomes like a desolate wasteland.
verses.8: And Nothra, the daughter of Zion, was like a statue in her garden; she was like a city built on rock.
verses.9: May the Lord, our God, grant us some survivors from this disaster. We will be able to live again, and our blood will not be shed anymore.
verses.10: Hear the words of Jehovah, officers of Sodom! Listen to the teachings of our God, people of Amorah.
verses.11: Why do you offer so much sacrifice? The LORD says, “I have no desire for oxen, milk, blood, sheep, or other offerings.” I don’t want any of these things.
verses.12: For when you come to see their faces, who is asking for this from you? It’s Ramesh who is asking for it.
verses.13: Do not add any more offerings as gifts. It’s a burden for me. It’s a new year, and Passover is approaching. I can’t bear it anymore.
verses.14: Your new year and your upcoming holidays were a source of hatred for my soul. I was forced to endure these hardships.
verses.15: And when you separate yourselves from me, my eyes will be filled with tears from you. Even though you pray, I won’t hear your prayers. Your tears fill my eyes with sorrow.
verses.16: They were cleansed; they were saved. Remove the evil from among you, from before my eyes. The evil shall cease.
verses.17: It is better to ask for judgment from those who are capable of making fair judgments. They will surely judge fairly, regardless of the circumstances.
verses.18: Please go and be wise. May the LORD say, “If our sins are like years of snow that cover everything, or if they are like nails that pierce through our hearts, then so be it.”
verses.19: If you eat and if you hear the good things of the land, then you will be satisfied.
verses.20: And if we are destroyed and destroyed, they will be eaten by fire. For the mouth of the LORD speaks.
verses.21: How miserable was Zona Kriya’s life! She was filled with justice and righteousness. But now, she is being murdered.
verses.22: Your tent was a place for you to rest in the water.
verses.23: Thieves and their companions all love to cause harm and harm others. They never punish those who are innocent, and they never take revenge on those who have no fault in their actions.
verses.24: Therefore, let the Lord God, the army of Israel’s king, comfort us and heal our wounds from our enemies.
verses.25: And I will lay my hand on you, and I will bind your feet with ropes. I will also capture all your treasures.
verses.26: And I will hear your judgments once again, and I will act according to your advice from the beginning. Then, I will call you “the city of righteousness.”
verses.27: She will be judged according to justice, and her return will be in righteousness.
verses.28: And the wicked and sinners will be punished together. Those who abandon the LORD will also be punished.
verses.29: For they will be like sheep that have been taken captive from their homes, and they will be hidden in the dens that you have chosen for them.
verses.30: For you will be like a boat that has no water in it. You’re like a ship without any water to float on.
verses.31: And it shall be a blessing for the girl, and its effect will be to bring about destruction. Both of them will act together, and there will be no stopping them.
